name: Norowareta Hime to Ibara no Tou
original_name: 呪われた姫といばらの塔
source:
―When I turn 15 years old, I will fall asleep forever―

Rose is a 14-year-old princess living in a castle surrounded by forests.

A party to celebrate Rose's 15th birthday one month later.
Rose was looking forward to the party, and even if people gossiped, everyone looked excited, until someone revealed the truth to her.

"You are cursed". When she turns 15, she will die after touching a spinning wheel.

She was cursed at birth by an evil wizard, and even if her parents burnt all the spinning wheels in the kingdom, she keeps having more and more nightmares involving thorns and spinning wheels! Who will be the one to save her from her cruel fate?
translation:
——當我年滿15歲，就會永遠沉睡——

蘿澤是一位14歲的公主，住在森林環繞的城堡裡。

再過一個月，就要舉辦慶祝蘿澤15歲生日的宴會了。
蘿澤滿心期待著這場宴會。雖然有人竊竊私語，但大家看起來都很興奮，直到有人向她揭開了真相。

「你被詛咒了。」年滿15歲時，她將因觸碰紡車而死去。

她一出生就被邪惡的巫師施下了詛咒。即使父母燒燬了王國裡所有的紡車，她仍不斷做著與荊棘和紡車有關的惡夢！究竟誰能將她從殘酷的命運中拯救出來？
